description: This file defines a test fixture class 'TestAppFactory' for an ASP.NET Core application, used to create an in-memory test host environment with customized configurations for testing purposes. It sets up a permissive authentication scheme, disables database connectivity to ensure tests are isolated from external dependencies, and configures the web host environment specifically for testing scenarios.

classes.name: TestAppFactory
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from WebApplicationFactory<Program> that sets up a custom testing environment for the backend API, including custom authentication and database configurations for testing scenarios.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Overrides the base method to configure the web host for testing, setting environment, app configuration, and services including custom authentication and database factory.

methods.name: TestAuthHandler
methods.description: A sealed inner class that implements a fake authentication handler to provide an always-authorized principal for testing.

methods.name: DbNotConfigured
methods.description: Returns an InvalidOperationException indicating that the database is not configured, used to prevent database access during tests.

methods.name: ThrowingNpgsqlConnectionFactory
methods.description: A sealed class inheriting from NpgsqlConnectionFactory that throws an exception on any attempt to open a connection, ensuring database access is blocked during tests.
